quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through a symbol means that action is not allowed. In this case, right turns are forbidden.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is one-way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign alerts you to a curve in the road ahead.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must always let pedestrians cross. Pay attention when driving through intersections or turning, especially near children.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and vehicles with the minimum number of passengers shown can use this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes very slippery when wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. You must stop if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right or continue straight.
You may turn left or continue straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn right or continue straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you can either turn right or go straight ahead.

questions.question: What type of sign is this?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped and yellow with black lettering or symbols. They warn you about special situations or hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends. Move to the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends. Move to the left lane.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the right lane is ending. Traffic in the right lane must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right side of the divider ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver bends their left arm at the elbow and points downward, it means they are slowing down or stopping. Riders use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals to show their intentions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign is yellow with black markings. It tells drivers to slow down because the road ahead has curves. Adjust your speed to stay safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There are bumps in the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low ground railroad crossing. The railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. Low vehicles may get stuck or dragged on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and diamond-shaped. This sign warns drivers to be careful when the road is wet because it becomes slippery and harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. This sign means right turns are not allowed here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign is yellow with black markings. It tells drivers to be careful when the road is wet because it can become slippery.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down when approaching railroad tracks. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for trains to pass before crossing.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: A community group is picking up trash on the highway ahead.
Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or near the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this area.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Stop only if other cars are coming.

questions.explanation: This sign (with the arrow below) shows where bicycles cross or ride. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles may cross or ride near traffic.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of an intersection ahead. A road joins from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.
There is a traffic light ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic light ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a traffic light at the next intersection.

questions.question: On the freeway, you see a "Merging traffic" sign. You should:

options.text: Always stay at your current speed.
Speed up to avoid traffic congestion.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic in.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic in.
questions.explanation: When on a road with two or more lanes, make room for entering vehicles. If the lane next to you is empty, move over to let them enter.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, you:

options.text: Can either continue through or exit the freeway from your lane.
Can stay in your lane and continue through.
Must exit the freeway if you stay in your lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway if you stay in your lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will exit the freeway. You must either change lanes to continue through or exit the freeway.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left, it means they plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has a series of turns and curves.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This yellow diamond warning sign alerts drivers that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: This sign tells you:

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.explanation: This sign warns of a winding road with three or more curves ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns drivers to watch for bicycles crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road intersects with a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guide rail.

questions.question: This sign warns you that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a pedestrian crossing. Watch for people crossing your path. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if cars are approaching.
Come to a full stop, then go when safe.
Drive carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on crossing roads.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then go when safe.
questions.explanation: A stop sign means you must come to a complete stop. You must yield to all vehicles and pedestrians. Go again only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after a complete stop.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs show laws drivers must obey. This sign means right turns are not permitted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left turns on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left turns on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign is used with a traffic light. It tells drivers turning left on green that they do not have the right-of-way. They must wait for oncoming traffic to pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is ahead. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep driving at your current speed.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you a traffic signal is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A sharp right turn is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A sharp right turn is ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves sharply to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the direction traffic must flow on this street.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:

options.text: A curve in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A curve in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves to the right.

questions.question: The posted speed limit shows:

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed in good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower when conditions are not ideal, such as during rain or snow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign alerts drivers that there is low clearance ahead, such as under a bridge.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a traffic signal is ahead. Be ready for red lights, yellow lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means left turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means you cannot do that action. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They tell you about upcoming hazards. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign shows that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Drive carefully where people may be crossing.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you drive past this sign, you are going the wrong way and could have a head-on collision. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on a yellow background. They alert you to upcoming hazards. This sign means a steep hill is ahead. Slow down to drive safely.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is for one-way traffic only.
That due to upcoming roadwork, detour to the right.
Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down because the road ahead changes direction at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road curves sharply ahead (in this case, to the right). Slow down before the sharp curve, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: If you see this sign, you:

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: Regulatory signs are white and rectangular with black markings. You must obey these signs. This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that parking is not allowed here.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers turning left at a green light to yield to oncoming traffic. You can complete your turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic will soon become one lane ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean when riding in a group?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with their palm facing back, it means the group should come to a stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that a stop sign is coming. Slow down and get ready to stop completely.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When your left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it signals that you plan to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down and be ready to stop at the intersection. Let other drivers and pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you that traffic is merging from the right. Be prepared to allow the traffic to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has many turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Reduce your speed, avoid sudden braking or turns, and stay farther away from other vehicles.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and points one finger?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. When the lead rider raises their left arm and points one finger, it means all riders should line up single file.

questions.question: What does this road sign show?

options.text: The safest speed for a residential area.
The safest speed for an expressway exit.
The safest speed for an expressway entrance.
The safest speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safest speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the safest speed to drive when leaving a highway or expressway.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: There is a steep hill ahead.
Trucks are not allowed on an upcoming hill.
Trucks are on an upcoming hill.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a steep hill ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What is the main concern with this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may not work right because one side of your vehicle is higher.
A tire could be damaged if you drift onto the shoulder.
Your vehicle could slip if the shoulder has water.
You could lose control if a wheel drops onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control if a wheel drops onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the road. If your wheel drops onto a low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control of your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks can use an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead only allows one direction of traffic.
Only one car can fit on the bridge at a time.
The bridge may be too narrow to safely pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge may be too narrow to safely pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that the upcoming bridge may be too narrow to safely meet or pass a truck. Drive carefully in this area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the road in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a Yield sign. Slow down, check for traffic, and let pedestrians and other vehicles pass. Only stop if necessary.

questions.question: This shape and color of sign is a _____________ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used to show no passing zones.

questions.question: When a rider extends their left arm straight out to the left, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of turn signals. A left arm extended straight out means the rider plans to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic comes from both directions ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns that a lane is ending or the road is narrowing.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that an overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a lead rider extends their left arm out with palm facing down and swings it down to their side, riders following should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic may come from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, but you may not always need to stop.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then proceed if it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: At a stop sign, you must always come to a complete stop. Only proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What should you do at an intersection with a yield sign?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other traffic go first. You do not have to stop unless traffic is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow and black. They prepare you for road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Get ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: The center lane is only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it to pass other vehicles or drive straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yellow and black warning sign. It alerts you to a steep hill ahead. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid accidents.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: This is a yellow and black warning sign. It tells you a school zone is coming up. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: All eight-sided signs are stop signs. Come to a full stop, check for pedestrians and other traffic, then proceed when the intersection is clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. An island, median, or barrier is ahead. Stay to the right side of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that vehicles are entering the road from the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a traffic light is coming up. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign means a traffic light is ahead. Be ready to stop for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign tells you that traffic may enter from a side road ahead. Stay alert.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.
The road ahead curves left, then right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They warn drivers about upcoming hazards. This sign warns you that the road curves to the right first, then curves to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must bear right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to bear either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show the direction of a sharp curve. The chevron arrow points in the direction the road curves. Multiple chevron signs may appear throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means a action is prohibited. This sign means U-turns are not allowed in this location.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a divided highway is ahead. The road splits into two separate one-way roads with a median or divider between them. Keep to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction signs are orange. They warn drivers of work zones ahead. Slow down and drive carefully when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road may be slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming. Watch for trains before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you not to enter the road or driveway ahead. Turn around and find another route.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with their palm up and then swings their arm upward, it tells other riders to speed up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a person controlling traffic is ahead in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign warns you that a sharp turn is coming. Reduce your speed before you reach the turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a steep downhill slope ahead.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, what does it mean?
questions.explanation: This hand signal means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for traffic and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and yield the right-of-way if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. Slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the right lane will end ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are reserved for people with disability permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
These lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with multiple passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are reserved for people with disability permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disability permits.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the highest legal speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than this limit.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: From bottom to top, the order of traffic light colors is:
questions.explanation: From bottom to top, traffic lights are ordered as green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell drivers to stop and yield the right-of-way. You can proceed when it is safe.
